faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What companies ask us before starting their project.

q1.q: What software development services does BEMYTECH offer?
q1.a: We build custom software: web applications, cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android, SaaS platforms, artificial intelligence integrations, IT consulting and ongoing support. We cover the full cycle: discovery, UX/UI design, development, cloud deployment and maintenance.

q2.q: How much does it cost to develop a custom web or mobile application?
q2.a: It depends on the scope and complexity of the project. After a free discovery call we define requirements and deliver a clear proposal with timelines and costs, no strings attached. Message us on WhatsApp and get your quote the same day.

q3.q: How long does it take to build a digital product?
q3.a: A working MVP usually takes 6 to 12 weeks depending on scope. We work in short sprints with functional deliveries every week, so you see real progress from the start.

q4.q: Do you work with companies outside Pereira or Colombia?
q4.a: Yes. We are based in Pereira, Colombia, and work remotely with companies across Colombia and Latin America. Our products already operate in several countries in the region.

q5.q: Can you integrate artificial intelligence into my business?
q5.a: Yes. We implement applied AI solutions: WhatsApp chatbots, process automation, data analysis and custom models, like our Visual Emotion platform for emotion analysis in interviews.

q6.q: Do you offer support and maintenance after launch?
q6.a: Always. All our projects include post-launch support: monitoring, evolutionary maintenance and continuous improvements under service level agreements (SLA).
